Functional Focus. in the light of the efforts to shift public
expenditure management from cost-based to performance-based, the Departrnent of
Budget and Management shall accordingly, effect policy, organizational, functional and
operational refocusing strategies that will address the following priority concems:
Adoption of a medium-term expenditure framework that would consider a
level of expenditures not only for the budget year but for subsequent years,
as well, and would enable a more predictable planning environment for
b. Adoption of measures to enhance efficiency in allowing and utilizing
resources through, among others, the grant of more authority and flexibility
to agencies in budget utilization and provision of performance incentives;
Deveiopment an<i impiementation of a performance monitoring and
evaluation system that would be related to resource allocation.

Organizatianal and Operational Adjustments in the DBM. To
ensure that the above priority concems will be effectively undertaken, the Secretary of
the Department of Budget and Management shall review its existing operational
processes, systems and setup, and determine appropriate mechanisms and strategies,
subject to existing organizational and staffing guidelines and standards. In compliance
with these requirements, the following considerations should be taken:
Ensuring the conduct of policy researches/studies and standard-setting on
budgeting and management;
Integration of related/homogeneous activities in the Department alongr three
rnajor functional categories: policy and management services, budget
gperations, and internal administrative and support services;
Strengthening of the functions of the budget operation units from tirose on
fund releasing/realignment to agency performance assessment and
monitoring of budget utilization;

As part of the DBM's continuiifg efforts to institute budgeting and management

SECTION 3, Redeployment of Personnel. As necessary, the existing personnel
of the DBM shall be redeployed in accordance with the requirements of the revised
organization structure and staffing pattern and civil service rules and regulations. Such
redeployment shall not result in the dirninution in rank and compensation of affected

Funding. The financial resources required to implement the
revised staffing pattern shall be taken from funds available in the DBM, provided that the
necessary organizational and staffing modifications shall not entail additional funds for
Personal Services.

Effectivify. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
